riskAnalysis: R03 confirmed the repeated-separator remediation but retained R02-F02 and identified one new high blocker: taskctl could accept a forged approved recovery projection that retained open blocking findings because only recoveryctl validated sequential closures. The remediation centralizes immutable ledger, attempt, candidate, evidence, reviewer, result, finding, and closure validation in taskctl and invokes it before any real amendment append. The executable fixture now preserves every prior attempt, creates a lawful strict-descendant successor, explicitly closes all open findings, validates GRR-0001 immediately before append, and proves that an approved ledger with omitted closures is denied with byte-stable backlog state. Because this changes shared governance controls, the exact 109-test focused suite and all 118 governed-file quality checks were run at candidate cb27290367a76fe2681b2a97552453f4f7803c29; authority, backlog, recovery, review-site, generated-view, and diff checks also pass.
